title: Best Practices for Moving from Correlation to Causation in Ecological Research
The Impact of Experiments on Environmental Policy and Natural Resource Policy
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Experiments are sometimes viewed as being too limited to provide input into policy. Contrary to this perspective, we document diverse ways in which experimental findings have influenced environmental and natural resource policy decisions. We show how experiments have informed or changed the designs of emissions trading programs, conservation auctions, pro-environmental initiatives directed at households, and regulatory enforcement and compliance schemes. Experiments have also produced nonmarket demand estimates that have informed government regulatory analyses. We highlight the context and conditions that produced these experiment-policy links and offer insights into how researchers can better engage with the policy-making process and increase the impact of experimental research on policy.
abstract_zh: 有人认为实验过于局限，无法为政策提供参考。与这一观点相反，我们记录了实验研究结果影响环境和自然资源政策决策的多种途径。我们展示了实验如何为排放交易计划、保护拍卖、面向家庭的亲环境倡议，以及监管执法和合规机制的设计提供信息或促成改变。实验还产生了非市场需求估计，为政府的监管分析提供了依据。我们强调了产生这些实验与政策联系的背景和条件，并就研究人员如何更好地参与政策制定过程、提升实验研究对政策的影响，提供了若干见解。

Still Money for Nothing? Two decades of empirical evaluation of conservation investments
abstract: Twenty years ago, the landmark paper “Money for Nothing?” argued that biodiversity conservation relied too little on empirical evidence. It called for more evaluations of conservation effectiveness based on explicit counterfactuals, comparing observed outcomes with those that would likely have occurred in the absence of intervention. To assess progress towards this goal, we systematically reviewed the study designs used to evaluate one of the most widely implemented conservation interventions: protected areas. Across 614 studies published over the past two decades, half still relied on simple Before-After or Control-Impact designs that do not reliably support causal inferences, although their use has declined in recent years. The other half used more formal causal identification strategies, most commonly conditioning strategies that control for observed confounders. However, most of these studies lacked pre-protection outcome data, limiting their ability to address unobserved confounders. Because causal claims depend on causal assumptions, it is notable that few studies stated these assumptions explicitly, let alone interrogated their plausibility. Although the design of conservation impact evaluations has advanced substantially, much remains to be improved. Combining causal inference methods with expanding data streams from remote sensing and biodiversity monitoring offers a major opportunity to strengthen the evidence base for conservation.
abstract_zh: 二十年前，具有里程碑意义的论文《Money for Nothing?》（“白送的钱？”）指出，生物多样性保护过于缺乏实证证据的支撑。该文呼吁开展更多基于明确反事实的保护成效评估，即将观察到的结果与在没有干预情况下可能出现的结果进行比较。为评估该目标的进展，我们系统回顾了保护领域实施最为广泛的干预之一——保护区——所使用的研究设计。在过去二十年发表的614项研究中，一半仍依赖于简单的前后对比或控制-影响设计，这些设计无法可靠地支持因果推断，尽管其使用近年来有所减少。另一半研究采用了更为正式的因果识别策略，最常见的是控制可观测混杂因素的条件化策略。然而，这些研究大多缺乏保护前的结果数据，限制了其处理不可观测混杂因素的能力。由于因果结论依赖于因果假设，值得注意的是，很少有研究明确陈述这些假设，更不用说检验其合理性。尽管保护影响评估的设计已取得显著进展，但仍有大量工作有待改进。将因果推断方法与来自遥感和生物多样性监测的日益增多的数据流相结合，为加强保护领域的证据基础提供了重大机遇。

title: Beyond Adoption: The persistence of conservation and climate-smart agricultural practices in the United States
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Achieving sustainability goals requires that humans change their behavior not just once but persistently. Yet despite decades of research on the adoption of conservation and climate-smart agricultural practices, little is known about the extent to which these practices persist over time. One key reason is the lack of longitudinal, field-level data. Using ground-verified, longitudinal data on cover cropping across thousands of farm parcels in Indiana (USA), we find that persistence is low and contrasts sharply with the predictions made by Indiana conservation experts. We also find low persistence in a new national dataset of self-reported cover cropping by farm operators. The potential for low behavioral persistence in sustainable agricultural practices raises essential questions about the design of conservation programs and the modeling and valuation of ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 实现可持续发展目标要求人类不仅一次性、而且持续地改变行为。尽管关于保护性农业和气候智慧型农业措施采用情况的研究已持续数十年，但人们对这些措施在多大程度上能够长期维持知之甚少。一个关键原因在于缺乏纵向的田间层面数据。利用印第安纳州（美国）数千块农田地块上经地面核实的覆盖作物纵向数据，我们发现其持续性很低，这与印第安纳州保护专家的预测形成鲜明对比。我们还在一个新的全国性数据集（农场经营者自我报告的覆盖作物种植情况）中发现了同样的低持续性。可持续农业实践中行为持续性较低的可能性，引发了关于保护计划设计以及生态系统服务建模与估值的根本性问题。

title: Conservation Impacts and Hidden Actions in a Randomized Trial of a Marine Pay-to-release Program
abstract: Incentive payments could cost-effectively and equitably achieve biodiversity conservation goals but could also trigger unintended countervailing actions. Here, we report on a preregistered, randomized controlled trial of a pay-to-release program among small-scale, Indonesian fishing vessels for the release of two critically endangered marine taxa from fishing gear: hammerhead sharks and wedgefish. A conventional monitoring approach, which quantifies impacts based on conservation-relevant actions (i.e., numbers of live releases), implies that the program was successful: a 71 and 4% reduction in wedgefish and hammerhead shark mortality, respectively. The experimental data, however, imply that the pay-to-release program also induced some vessels to increase their catch, thereby decreasing wedgefish mortality by only 25% [confidence interval (CI): −49 to 10%] and increasing hammerhead mortality by 44% (CI: 8 to 92%). Our results do not imply that pay-to-release programs cannot work but rather demonstrate the complexity of designing incentive-based conservation programs and the importance of piloting them using experimental designs before scaling up.
abstract_zh: 激励性支付能够以具有成本效益且公平的方式实现生物多样性保护目标，但也可能引发意料之外的抵消性行为。在此，我们报告了一项预先注册的随机对照试验结果，该试验针对印度尼西亚小型渔船开展了“付费放生”计划，旨在让渔船将两种极度濒危的海洋类群（双髻鲨和琵琶鲼）从渔具中释放。以保护相关行为（即活体放生数量）为依据的常规监测方法量化影响，表明该计划是成功的：琵琶鲼和双髻鲨的死亡率分别降低了71%和4%。然而，实验数据表明，该付费放生计划也促使部分渔船增加了渔获量，从而使琵琶鲼死亡率仅降低25%（置信区间：−49%至10%），双髻鲨死亡率则上升了44%（置信区间：8%至92%）。我们的结果并不意味着付费放生计划无法奏效，而是表明设计基于激励的保护计划十分复杂，并说明了在扩大规模之前，采用实验设计进行试点的重要性。

title: Designing Causal Mediation Analyses to Quantify Intermediary Processes in Ecology
Lessons Learned from 10 Years of Embedding Experimentation in Agri-environmental Programs in the United States
RCTs in the Wild: Designing and implementing conservation programs as randomized controlled trials
abstract: Experimental evaluation of environmental programs, including those aiming to conserve biodiversity, are rarer than those of social programs. However, there is growing interest in conducting such evaluations in conservation. Randomized Control Trials (RCTs), in which units are randomly assigned to receive one of two or more treatments, can avoid biases associated with observational designs and provide reliable estimation of program effectiveness. We present a typology of conservation RCTs, which differentiates between interventions that have a direct impact on biodiversity outcomes and those where the impact is mediated through changes in human behavior. With a focus on RCTs in behaviorally mediated conservation programs, which have received limited attention, we examine: 1) technical challenges (selection of randomization unit, avoiding interference between units, ensuring excludability and external validity) and solutions, 2) ethical and practical challenges and 3) incentives that conservation organizations have to run RCTs. We end by summarizing the steps needed for good design and transparent reporting of RCTs. RCTs are not always appropriate, but we believe conservation science and practice would benefit from their wider application. By demystifying RCTs of conservation programs we hope that this article will serve as a practical, grounded guide to foster broader adoption.
abstract_zh: 环境项目（包括旨在保护生物多样性的项目）的实验评估，比社会项目少见。然而，人们对在保护领域开展此类评估的兴趣日益增长。随机对照试验（RCT）是指将单位随机分配接受两种或多种处理之一，可以避免观察性设计带来的偏误，并对项目效果进行可靠估计。我们提出了保护类RCT的类型学，区分对生物多样性结果有直接影响的干预，以及通过人类行为变化间接产生影响的干预。我们重点关注行为中介型保护项目中的RCT（这类研究受到的关注有限），并考察了以下内容：1）技术挑战（随机化单位的选择、避免单位间干扰、确保排他性和外部效度）及其解决方案；2）伦理与实践挑战；以及3）保护组织开展RCT的动机。最后，我们总结了良好设计和透明报告RCT所需的步骤。RCT并非总是适用，但我们相信，保护科学与实践将从其更广泛的应用中受益。我们希望通过厘清保护项目RCT的神秘面纱，使本文成为一份务实、扎实的指南，以促进其更广泛的采用。

title: Underpowered Studies and Exaggerated Effects: A replication and re-evaluation of the magnitude of anchoring effects
Behavioral Biases among Producers: Experimental evidence of anchoring in procurement auctions
Business-as-usual Trends Will Largely Miss 2030 Global Conservation Targets
abstract: To address climate change and global biodiversity loss, the world must hit three important international conservation targets by 2030: protect 30% of terrestrial and marine areas, halt and reverse forest loss, and restore 350 Mha of degraded and deforested landscapes. Here, we (1) provide estimates of the gaps between these globally agreed targets and business-as-usual trends; (2) identify examples of rapid past trend-shifts towards achieving the targets; and (3) link these past trend-shifts to different levers. Our results suggest that under a business-as-usual scenario, the world will fail to achieve all three targets. However, trend-shifts that rapidly “bend the curve” have happened in the past and these should therefore be fostered. These trend-shifts are linked to transformative change levers that include environmental governance, economic factors, values, and knowledge. Further research on trend-shifts, as well as bold action on underlying levers, is urgently needed to meet 2030 global conservation targets.
abstract_zh: 为应对气候变化和全球生物多样性丧失，世界必须在2030年前实现三个重要的国际保护目标：保护30%的陆地和海洋区域，遏制并扭转森林损失，以及恢复3.5亿公顷退化和被砍伐的景观。在此，我们(1)估算了这些全球共识目标与“照常营业”（business-as-usual）趋势之间的差距；(2)识别了过去实现目标所需的趋势迅速转变的案例；(3)将这些过去的趋势转变与不同的推动因素联系起来。我们的结果表明，在照常营业的情景下，世界将无法实现全部三个目标。然而，过去确实发生过能够迅速“扭转曲线”的趋势转变，因此应当加以推动。这些趋势转变与变革性推动因素相关，包括环境治理、经济因素、价值观和知识。亟需进一步研究趋势转变，并对基础性推动因素采取大胆行动，以实现2030年全球保护目标。

title: Applying Behavioral Science to Agriculture, Food, And Agri-Environmental Policymaking
Clarifying the Effect of Biodiversity on Productivity in Natural Ecosystems with Longitudinal Data and Methods for Causal Inference
abstract: Causal effects of biodiversity on ecosystem functions can be estimated using experimental or observational designs — designs that pose a tradeoff between drawing credible causal inferences from correlations and drawing generalizable inferences. Here, we develop a design that reduces this tradeoff and revisits the question of how plant species diversity affects productivity. Our design leverages longitudinal data from 43 grasslands in 11 countries and approaches borrowed from fields outside of ecology to draw causal inferences from observational data. Contrary to many prior studies, we estimate that increases in plot-level species richness caused productivity to decline: a 10% increase in richness decreased productivity by 2.4%, 95% CI [−4.1, −0.74]. This contradiction stems from two sources. First, prior observational studies incompletely control for confounding factors. Second, most experiments plant fewer rare and non-native species than exist in nature. Although increases in native, dominant species increased productivity, increases in rare and non-native species decreased productivity, making the average effect negative in our study. By reducing the tradeoff between experimental and observational designs, our study demonstrates how observational studies can complement prior ecological experiments and inform future ones.
abstract_zh: 生物多样性对生态系统功能的因果效应，可以通过实验或观察设计进行估计，而这两类设计之间存在权衡：前者可从相关关系中得出可信的因果推断，后者则可得出可推广的推断。在此，我们开发了一种能够减轻这一权衡的设计，并重新审视植物物种多样性如何影响生产力的问题。我们的设计利用了来自11个国家43个草原的纵向数据，并借鉴了生态学以外领域的方法，从观察数据中得出因果推断。与许多先前研究相反，我们估计，地块层面物种丰富度的增加导致生产力下降：物种丰富度增加10%，生产力下降2.4%，95%置信区间为[−4.1, −0.74]。这一矛盾源于两个方面。第一，先前的观察性研究未能充分控制混杂因素。第二，大多数实验种植的稀有和非本地物种少于自然界中存在的数量。尽管本地优势物种的增加提高了生产力，但稀有和非本地物种的增加却降低了生产力，使得本研究中的平均效应为负。通过缩小实验设计与观察设计之间的权衡，本研究表明，观察性研究可以补充先前的生态学实验，并为未来的实验提供参考。

title: Create a Culture of Experiments in Environmental Programs
Credibility Crisis in Agricultural Economics
abstract: We provide empirical evidence of research practices that can undermine the credibility of empirical research in agricultural economics. We find that, in four popular journals, most studies are underpowered, a characteristic that, when coupled with publication bias, yields unreliable and exaggerated effect sizes. This problem is exacerbated by selective reporting of statistically significant results and multiple hypothesis testing without any adjustments to statistical inferences. Survey respondents self‐report engaging in practices that are consistent with these empirical findings. Addressing these problems in agricultural economics will require that editors, reviewers, and donors change the norms and incentives for authors.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了实证证据，说明哪些研究实践可能削弱农业经济学实证研究的可信度。我们发现，在四份热门期刊中，大多数研究的统计检验功效不足；这一特征与发表偏倚相结合，会产生不可靠且被夸大的效应量。选择性报告统计显著结果，以及在未对统计推断作任何调整的情况下进行多重假设检验，使这一问题更加严重。受访者自我报告的行为与上述实证发现相一致。要解决农业经济学中的这些问题，编辑、审稿人和资助方需要改变作者所面临的规范与激励。

Social Comparisons and Groundwater Use: Evidence from Colorado and Kansas
abstract: In the United States, agriculture is responsible for the majority of consumptive water use. To reduce consumptive use in water scarce regions, policymakers have implemented a number of costly interventions. These interventions range from land retirement to subsidies that encourage the adoption of efficient irrigation technologies. In nonagricultural contexts, costly policy interventions have been complemented by low‐cost interventions inspired by behavioral economics. Whether these behavioral interventions are effective in the context of commercial farming is not well understood. In a preregistered, randomized field intervention, we estimate the impact of social (peer) comparisons on agricultural groundwater users in Colorado and Kansas. More than three thousand irrigators were randomized to receive either an annual peer comparison or no comparison. The peer comparison contrasted each irrigator's groundwater use to the distribution of use by neighboring irrigators. The comparison intervention reduced average annual groundwater use by 4.05% [95% CI (−5.87%, − 2.21%)], resulting in an aggregate reduction of more than 21,000 acre‐feet per year at a cost less than $1.31 per acre‐foot conserved. The estimated treatment effect was larger among irrigators with lower pre‐intervention water use. In the 3‐year experiment, we observed no evidence that the treatment effect substantially attenuated over time. We did, however, detect within‐irrigator spillovers in the treatment group: groundwater use also declined among wells that were not included in the peer comparisons (peer comparisons included a maximum of three wells). The results imply that social comparisons can be a cost‐effective tool, alongside other policy interventions, aimed at reducing agricultural water use.
abstract_zh: 在美国，农业占消耗性用水的大部分。为减少缺水地区的消耗性用水，政策制定者实施了许多成本高昂的干预措施，从土地退耕到鼓励采用高效灌溉技术的补贴不等。在非农业领域，成本高昂的政策干预已辅以受行为经济学启发的低成本干预。然而，这些行为干预在商业化农业中是否有效，目前尚不清楚。在一项预先注册的随机田间干预中，我们估计了社会（同伴）比较对科罗拉多州和堪萨斯州农业地下水使用者的影响。3000多名灌溉者被随机分配，接受年度同伴比较或不接受任何比较。同伴比较将每位灌溉者的地下水使用量与邻近灌溉者的用水分布进行对比。该比较干预使平均年地下水使用量减少4.05%（95%置信区间[−5.87%, −2.21%]），总计每年减少超过21000英亩英尺水量，每节约一英亩英尺的成本不到1.31美元。处理效应在干预前用水量较低的灌溉者中更大。在为期3年的实验中，我们没有观察到处理效应随时间大幅衰减的证据。然而，我们确实在处理组内发现了灌溉者内部的溢出效应：未纳入同伴比较的水井（同伴比较最多包括三口井）的地下水使用量也有所下降。研究结果表明，社会比较可以成为一种具有成本效益的工具，与其他政策干预一道，用于减少农业用水。

title: Unraveling Complex Causal Processes that Affect Sustainability Requires More Integration between Empirical and Modeling Approaches
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Scientists seek to understand the causal processes that generate sustainability problems and determine effective solutions. Yet, causal inquiry in nature–society systems is hampered by conceptual and methodological challenges that arise from nature–society interdependencies and the complex dynamics they create. Here, we demonstrate how sustainability scientists can address these challenges and make more robust causal claims through better integration between empirical analyses and process- or agent-based modeling. To illustrate how these different epistemological traditions can be integrated, we present four studies of air pollution regulation, natural resource management, and the spread of COVID-19. The studies show how integration can improve empirical estimates of causal effects, inform future research designs and data collection, enhance understanding of the complex dynamics that underlie observed temporal patterns, and elucidate causal mechanisms and the contexts in which they operate. These advances in causal understanding can help sustainability scientists develop better theories of phenomena where social and ecological processes are dynamically intertwined and prior causal knowledge and data are limited. The improved causal understanding also enhances governance by helping scientists and practitioners choose among potential interventions, decide when and how the timing of an intervention matters, and anticipate unexpected outcomes. Methodological integration, however, requires skills and efforts of all involved to learn how members of the respective other tradition think and analyze nature–society systems.
abstract_zh: 科学家试图理解产生可持续性问题的因果过程，并确定有效的解决方案。然而，自然—社会系统中的因果探究受到概念和方法论上的挑战，这些挑战源于自然与社会的相互依存及其所产生的复杂动态。本文展示了可持续性科学家如何应对这些挑战，并通过加强经验分析与过程模型或主体模型之间的整合，做出更稳健的因果论断。为说明这些不同的认识论传统如何结合，我们介绍了四项关于空气污染管制、自然资源管理和新冠病毒传播的研究。这些研究表明，整合可以改进对因果效应的经验估计，为未来的研究设计和数据收集提供参考，增进对观察到的时间模式背后复杂动态的理解，并阐明因果机制及其运行的情境。这些因果认识上的进展有助于可持续性科学家发展更好的理论，用于解释那些社会与生态过程动态交织、且先验因果知识和数据有限的现象。改进后的因果理解也有助于科学家与实践者在潜在干预措施之间作出选择，判断干预时机何时以及如何重要，并预见意外结果，从而增强治理能力。然而，方法论上的整合要求所有参与者付出技能与努力，学习其他传统的研究者如何思考和分析自然—社会系统。

title: A Reassessment of the Potential for Loss-framed Incentive Contracts to Increase Productivity: A meta-analysis and real-effort experiment
Lottery Incentives and Resource Management: Evidence from the Agricultural Data Reporting Incentive Program (AgDRIP)
Private Costs of Carbon Emissions Abatement by Limiting Beef Consumption and Vehicle Use in the United States
abstract: A popular strategy for mitigating climate change is to persuade or incentivize individuals to limit behaviors associated with high greenhouse gas emissions. In this study, adults in the mid-Atlantic United States bid in an auction to receive compensation for eliminating beef consumption or limiting vehicle use. The auction incentivized participants to reveal their true costs of accepting these limits for periods ranging from one week to one year. Compliance with the conditions of the auction was confirmed via a random field audit of the behavioral changes. The estimated median abatement costs were greater than $600 per tCO2e for beef consumption and $1,300 per tCO2e for vehicle use, values much higher than the price of carbon offsets and most estimates of the social cost of carbon. Although these values may decline over time with experience or broader social adoption, they imply that policies that encourage innovations to reduce the costs of behavior change, such as meat alternatives or emission-free vehicles, may be a more fruitful than those that limit beef consumption or vehicle use.
abstract_zh: 应对气候变化的一种流行策略，是说服或激励个人限制与高温室气体排放相关的行为。在本研究中，美国中大西洋地区的成年人参与拍卖，以获得放弃食用牛肉或限制车辆使用的补偿。拍卖机制激励参与者揭示其接受这些限制的真实成本，限制期从一周到一年不等。拍卖条件的遵守情况通过对行为变化的随机实地审计得到确认。估计的减排成本中位数为：牛肉消费每吨CO2当量超过600美元，车辆使用每吨CO2当量超过1300美元。这些数值远高于碳抵消的价格，也高于大多数碳的社会成本估计。尽管这些数值可能随着经验积累或更广泛的社会采纳而下降，但它们表明，相比于限制牛肉消费或车辆使用的政策，鼓励创新以降低行为改变成本（如肉类替代品或零排放车辆）的政策可能更有成效。

title: The Choice of Message and Messenger to Drive Behavior Change that Averts the Health Impacts of Wildfires: An online randomized controlled experiment
abstract: BACKGROUND: To reduce the negative health effects from wildfire smoke exposure, effective risk and health communication strategies are vital. We estimated the behavioral effects from changes in message framing and messenger in public health messages about wildfire smoke on Facebook. METHODS: During September and October 2021, we conducted a preregistered online randomized controlled experiment in Facebook. Adult Facebook users (n = 1,838,100), living in nine wildfire-prone Western U.S. states, were randomly assigned to see one of two ad versions (narrative frame vs. informational frame) from one of two messengers (government vs. academic). We estimated the effects of narrative framing, the messenger, and their interactions on ad click-through rates, a measure of recipient information-seeking behavior. RESULTS: Narrative frame increased click-through rates by 25.3% (95% CI = 22.2, 28.4%), with larger estimated effects among males, recipients in areas with less frequent exposure to heavy wildfire smoke, and in areas where predominant political party affiliation of registered voters was Republican (although not statistically different from predominantly-Democrat areas). The estimated effect from an academic messenger compared to a government messenger was small and statistically nonsignificant (2.2%; 95% CI = - 0.3, 4.7%). The estimated interaction effect between the narrative framing and the academic messenger was also small and statistically nonsignificant (3.9%; 95% CI = - 1.1, 9.1%). CONCLUSIONS: Traditional public service announcements rely heavily on communicating facts (informational framing). Shifting from a fact-focused, informational framing to a story-focused, narrative framing could lead to more effective health communication in areas at risk of wildfires and in public health contexts more broadly. abstract_zh: 背景：为减少野火烟雾暴露对健康的负面影响，有效的风险与健康传播策略至关重要。我们估计了Facebook上关于野火烟雾的公共卫生信息在信息框架和信使方面的变化所带来的行为效应。方法：2021年9月和10月，我们在Facebook上开展了一项预先注册的在线随机对照实验。居住在美国西部九个易发野火州的成年Facebook用户（n = 1,838,100）被随机分配，看到两种广告版本之一（叙事框架对比信息框架），且信使为两者之一（政府对比学术机构）。我们估计了叙事框架、信使及其交互作用对广告点击率（衡量接收者寻求信息行为的指标）的影响。结果：叙事框架使点击率提高了25.3%（95% CI = 22.2, 28.4%），在男性、重度野火烟雾暴露较少地区的受众，以及登记选民中以共和党为主的地区，效应估计更大（尽管与以民主党为主的地区相比，差异在统计上并不显著）。与政府信使相比，学术信使的估计效应很小且统计上不显著（2.2%；95% CI = −0.3, 4.7%）。叙事框架与学术信使之间的交互效应同样很小且统计上不显著（3.9%；95% CI = −1.1, 9.1%）。结论：传统的公益宣传主要依赖传递事实（信息框架）。从以事实为中心的信息框架转向以故事为中心的叙事框架，可能在野火高风险地区以及更广泛的公共卫生情境中带来更为有效的健康传播。试验注册：注册日期为2021年8月19日；注册DOI：https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/JMWUF。

abstract: Elinor Ostrom won the Nobel Prize in Economics for demonstrating that humans can create rules and institutions that permit sustainable management of shared resources without resorting to privatization or government expropriation. One purported enabling condition for success is monitoring of the shared resource by community members. Whether such monitoring can be encouraged where it is absent, and thereby improve resource management, is not well understood. In a randomized trial, we assessed whether an externally encouraged, community-based monitoring program improved water management. After 1 y, we detect modest reductions in groundwater pumping and modest improvements in water quality and user satisfaction. Although replications are needed, the results imply that externally encouraged, community-based monitoring can improve the management of shared resources.
abstract_zh: 埃莉诺·奥斯特罗姆（Elinor Ostrom）因证明人类可以制定规则和制度，在不诉诸私有化或政府征收的情况下实现对共享资源的可持续管理，而获得诺贝尔经济学奖。一个被认为有利于成功的条件是社区成员对共享资源进行监测。在缺乏监测的地方，能否鼓励这种监测，从而改善资源管理，目前尚不清楚。在一项随机试验中，我们评估了外部鼓励的社区监测项目是否改善了水资源管理。一年后，我们发现地下水抽取有适度减少，水质和用户满意度有适度改善。尽管仍需进一步的重复研究，但结果表明，外部鼓励的社区监测能够改善共享资源的管理。

title: Conservation Outreach that Acknowledges Human Contributions to Climate Change does not Inhibit Action by U.S. farmers: Evidence from a large randomized controlled trial embedded in a federal program on soil health
abstract: Technologies and practices that reduce the environmental impacts of US agriculture are well documented. Less is known about how best to encourage their adoption. We report on the results of a large randomized controlled trial conducted with nearly 10,000 agricultural producers in the United States. The experiment was embedded in US Department of Agriculture outreach efforts to improve soil conservation practices. USDA varied the content of mailings to test two sets of competing theories about outreach to agricultural producers. Contrary to conventional wisdom, we find no evidence that acknowledging the link between climate change and agricultural production discourages conservation action. Furthermore, we find that producers who were invited to a webinar were less likely to take any action to learn more about conservation practices than producers who were not told about the webinar, a result that runs counter to the popular wisdom that offering more options leads to more action.

title: Using a Randomized Controlled Trial to Develop Conservation Strategies on Rented Farmlands
abstract: Addressing the environmental impacts of large‐scale agriculture requires innovative approaches to conservation program design and evaluation. We used a randomized controlled trial and a sample of 2225 landowners in the Mississippi River Basin to test a new conservation program that targets a growing but overlooked population—nonoperating landowners (NOLs). To spur adoption of conservation practices on farmland rented out by NOLs, the program provided NOLs with ready‐to‐use lease language and a financial incentive. The program's design was informed by field work, the behavioral science literature, and the social science literature on barriers to conservation on farmland. We cannot detect an effect on conservation practices from the lease language or the incentive. The take‐up rate for the incentive was one‐tenth the expected rate based on NOL responses to a hypothetical offer in a survey. The results underscore the importance of assessing program performance by rigorously testing programs in real conservation settings.
abstract_zh: 应对大规模农业的环境影响，需要在保护计划的设计与评估上采用创新方法。我们在密西西比河流域对2225名土地所有者进行了随机对照试验，以检验一项新的保护计划，该计划针对一个规模日益增长但长期被忽视的群体——非经营性土地所有者（nonoperating landowners, NOLs）。为促使非经营性土地所有者出租的农田采纳保护措施，该计划向他们提供了可直接使用的租约条款以及经济激励。该计划的设计参考了实地调研、行为科学文献以及关于农田保护障碍的社会科学文献。我们未能检测到租约条款或经济激励对保护措施产生的效果。激励措施的参与率仅为调查中非经营性土地所有者对假设性报价的回应所预期参与率的十分之一。这些结果表明，通过在真实的保护场景中严格检验计划，来评估计划绩效是十分重要的。

title: Causal Effect of Impervious Cover on Annual Flood Magnitude for the United States
abstract: Despite consensus that impervious surfaces increase flooding, the magnitude of the increase remains uncertain. This uncertainty largely stems from the challenge of isolating the effect of changes in impervious cover separate from other factors that also affect flooding. To control for these factors, prior study designs rely on either temporal or spatial variation in impervious cover. We leverage both temporal and spatial variation in a panel data regression design to isolate the effect of impervious cover on floods. With 39 years of data from 280 U.S. streamgages, we estimate that a one percentage point increase in impervious basin cover causes a 3.3% increase in annual flood magnitude (95%CI: 1.9%, 4.7%) on average. Using 2,109 streamgages, some of which have upstream regulation and/or overlapping basins, we estimate a larger effect: 4.6% (CI: 3.5%, 5.6%). The approach introduced here can be extended to estimate the causal effects of other drivers of hydrologic change.
abstract_zh: 尽管学界一致认为不透水地表会加剧洪涝，但其增幅究竟有多大仍不确定。这种不确定性很大程度上源于一个挑战：难以将不透水覆盖变化的效应与其他同样影响洪涝的因素区分开来。为控制这些因素，已有研究设计依赖于不透水覆盖在时间或空间上的变化。我们在面板数据回归设计中同时利用了时间和空间变化，以分离出不透水覆盖对洪涝的效应。基于美国280个流量站39年的数据，我们估计，流域不透水覆盖每增加一个百分点，平均将导致年度洪涝量级增加3.3%（95%置信区间：1.9%，4.7%）。使用2,109个流量站（其中一些存在上游调控和/或流域重叠）时，我们估计的效应更大：4.6%（置信区间：3.5%，5.6%）。本文提出的方法可以推广，用于估计水文变化其他驱动因素的因果效应。

Conditional Cash Transfers to Alleviate Poverty also Reduced Deforestation in Indonesia
abstract: Solutions to poverty and ecosystem degradation are often framed as conflicting. We ask whether Indonesia's national anti-poverty program, which transfers cash to hundreds of thousands of poor households, reduced deforestation as a side benefit. Although the program has no direct link to conservation, we estimate that it reduced tree cover loss in villages by 30% (95% confidence interval, 10 to 50%). About half of the avoided losses were in primary forests, and reductions were larger when participation density was higher. The economic value of the avoided carbon emissions alone compares favorably to program implementation costs. The program's environmental impact appears to be mediated through channels widely available in developing nations: consumption smoothing, whereby cash substitutes for deforestation as a form of insurance, and consumption substitution, whereby market-purchased goods substitute for deforestation-sourced goods. The results imply that anti-poverty programs targeted at the very poor can help achieve global environmental goals under certain conditions.
abstract_zh: 贫困问题与生态系统退化的解决方案常被视为相互冲突。我们探讨印度尼西亚的全国性扶贫计划（该计划向数十万贫困家庭转移现金）是否作为附带效益减少了森林砍伐。尽管该计划与生态保护没有直接联系，我们估计它使村庄的林木覆盖损失减少了30%（95%置信区间：10%至50%）。被避免的损失中约有一半发生在原始森林中，而参与密度较高时，减少幅度更大。仅避免的碳排放所带来的经济价值，就优于该计划的实施成本。该计划的环境影响似乎是通过发展中国家普遍存在的渠道实现的：一是消费平滑，即现金替代了作为一种保险形式的森林砍伐；二是消费替代，即市场购买的商品替代了来自森林砍伐的商品。研究结果表明，在特定条件下，针对最贫困人口的扶贫计划有助于实现全球环境目标。

abstract: Voluntary land conservation programs depend upon the willingness of land owners to participate. Since participation requires commitment to long‐term contracts, most studies on participation focus on changes to the pecuniary incentives facing land owners. This study presents a large‐scale field experiment within the USDA's Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) that examines whether informational outreach, including behavioral nudges, could improve land owners’ willingness to participate. The experiment evaluates the impact of three types of reminder letters on the rate at which land is offered into the CRP. We find that for the most well‐informed group, farms with expiring CRP contracts, the reminder letters did improve participation. We interpret this result as evidence of inattentive behavior. We do not detect any differences in the estimated treatment effects among the basic reminder letter and the letters augmented with peer comparisons and social norm messaging, nor do we detect any treatment effect among currently unenrolled farms. From a policy perspective, these results imply that the USDA can generate additional CRP offers among farms with expiring contracts at an average cost of $39 per additional offer. Assuming a twenty‐five million acre program, reminder letters sent during every sign‐up period would result in re‐enrollment offers from an additional 420,000 acres. Using simulations based on offers from prior CRP sign‐ups, we estimate that these additional offers in the CRP auction would reduce program costs. Depending on the year of simulation, the outreach effort achieves a benefit‐cost ratio of between 20:1 and 90:1.
abstract_zh: 自愿性土地保护计划依赖于土地所有者的参与意愿。由于参与需要签订长期合同，大多数关于参与的研究都聚焦于改变土地所有者面临的经济激励。本研究在美国农业部的保护储备计划（Conservation Reserve Program, CRP）中开展了一项大规模实地实验，考察包括行为助推在内的信息宣传能否提高土地所有者的参与意愿。该实验评估了三类提醒信对土地被纳入CRP报价比率的影响。我们发现，对于信息最充分的群体——合同即将到期的农场——提醒信确实提高了参与率。我们将这一结果解释为注意力不集中行为的证据。在基础提醒信与附加了同伴比较和社会规范信息的提醒信之间，我们未发现估计处理效应的差异；对于目前未参加计划的农场，我们也未检测到任何处理效应。从政策角度看，这些结果表明，美国农业部可以在合同即将到期的农场中以平均每份39美元的成本，额外获得CRP报价。假设计划规模为2500万英亩，在每个报名期都发送提醒信，将使额外420,000英亩土地获得续约报价。基于以往CRP报名的报价数据进行模拟，我们估计，这些额外报价进入CRP拍卖后将降低计划成本。根据模拟年份的不同，该推广工作的效益成本比介于20:1与90:1之间。

abstract: Community Forest Management (CFM) is a widespread conservation approach in the tropics. It is also promoted as a means by which payment for ecosystem services schemes can be implemented. However, evidence on its performance is weak. We investigated the effectiveness of CFM at reducing deforestation from 2000 to 2010 in Madagascar. To control for factors confounding impact estimates, we used statistical matching. We also contrasted the effects of CFM by whether commercial use of forest resources is allowed or not. We cannot detect an effect, on average, of CFM compared to no CFM, even when we restricted the sample to only where information suggests effective CFM implementation on the ground. Likewise, we cannot detect an effect of CFM where commercial use of natural resources is allowed. However, we can detect a reduction in deforestation in CFM that does not permit commercial uses, compared to no CFM or CFM allowing commercial uses. Our findings suggest that CFM and commercial use of forest resources are not guarantees of forest conservation and that differentiating among types of CFM is important.
abstract_zh: 社区森林管理（Community Forest Management, CFM）是热带地区广泛采用的保护方式。它也被视为实施生态系统服务付费计划的一种途径。然而，关于其成效的证据较为薄弱。我们考察了2000至2010年间马达加斯加社区森林管理在减少森林砍伐方面的有效性。为控制混淆影响估计的因素，我们采用了统计匹配方法。我们还根据是否允许商业性利用森林资源，对比了社区森林管理的效果。平均而言，与未实施社区森林管理相比，我们无法检测到社区森林管理的效应；即使将样本限制在有信息表明社区森林管理在实地得到有效执行的地区，结果依然如此。同样，在允许商业性利用自然资源的地区，我们也无法检测到社区森林管理的效应。然而，与未实施社区森林管理或允许商业性利用的社区森林管理相比，禁止商业性利用的社区森林管理能够减少森林砍伐。我们的研究结果表明，社区森林管理及森林资源的商业性利用并不能保证森林保护，区分不同类型的社区森林管理至关重要。

title: Advances in Measuring the Environmental and Social Impacts of Environmental Programs
venue: Annual Review of Environment and Resources
abstract: Inspired by the success of evidence-based medicine, environmental scholars and practitioners have grown enthusiastic about applying a similar evidence-based approach to solve some of the world's most pressing environmental problems. An important component of the evidence-based movement is the empirical evaluation of program and policy impacts. Impact evaluations draw heavily from recent advances in the empirical study of causal relationships—the effect of one thing on another. This review highlights the key components of these advances and characterizes the way in which they contribute to better evaluations of the environmental and social impacts of environmental programs. The review emphasizes that a solid understanding of these advances is required before environmental scholars and practitioners can begin to collect the relevant data, analyze them within credible research designs, and generate reliable evidence about the effectiveness of the myriad proposed solutions to the world's environmental and social problems.
abstract_zh: 受循证医学成功的启发，环境领域的学者与实践者对于将类似的循证方法应用于解决世界上一些最紧迫的环境问题产生了浓厚兴趣。循证运动的一个重要组成部分是对项目和政策影响的实证评估。影响评估在很大程度上借鉴了因果关系（即一事物对另一事物的效应）实证研究的最新进展。本文综述了这些进展的关键组成部分，并刻画了它们如何促进对环境项目的环境和社会影响进行更好的评估。综述强调，环境学者和实践者只有充分理解这些进展，才能开始收集相关数据、在可信的研究设计中加以分析，并就世界环境与社会问题的众多解决方案的有效性形成可靠的证据。

title: Are Voters More Likely to Contribute to Other Public Goods? Evidence from a Large-Scale Randomized Policy Experiment
Quantifying Causal Mechanisms to Determine How Protected Areas Affect Poverty through Changes in Ecosystem Services and Infrastructure
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Scholars are accumulating evidence about the effects of environmental programs on social outcomes. Quantifying these effects is important, but to design better programs we need to understand how these effects arise. Little is known about the mechanisms through which ecosystem conservation programs affect human welfare. Our study demonstrates that, with existing data and appropriate empirical designs, scientists and policymakers can elucidate these previously unidentified mechanisms. We estimate how Costa Rica’s protected area system reduced poverty in neighboring communities. Nearly two-thirds of the impact is causally attributable to opportunities afforded by tourism. The rest is attributable to unobserved mechanisms. Changes in infrastructure or land cover contributed little, on average, to poverty reduction.
abstract_zh: 学界正在积累关于环境项目对社会结果影响的证据。量化这些效应固然重要，但若要设计更好的项目，我们还需理解这些效应是如何产生的。关于生态系统保护项目影响人类福祉的机制，我们所知甚少。本研究表明，利用现有数据和恰当的实证设计，科学家与政策制定者能够阐明这些此前未被识别的机制。我们估计了哥斯达黎加的保护区体系如何减少了周边社区的贫困。其影响近三分之二在因果上可归因于旅游业带来的机会。其余部分则归因于未观测到的机制。平均而言，基础设施或土地覆被的变化对减贫的贡献很小。

The Effects of Protected Area Systems on Ecosystem Restoration: a quasi-experimental design to estimate the impact of Costa Rica's protected area system on forest regrowth
abstract: Global efforts to protect forest biodiversity and ecosystem services rely heavily on protected areas. Although these areas primarily aim to prevent losses from deforestation and degradation, they can also contribute to restoration. Previous evaluations of protected area impacts focus on avoided deforestation and fires. In contrast, we focus on the additional regrowth induced by Costa Rica’s renowned system of parks and reserves. We use a quasi-experimental empirical design to control for confounding baseline characteristics that affect both regrowth and the assignment of protection. Between 1960 and 1997, an estimated 13.5% of previously unforested lands inside protected areas reforested because they were afforded protection. The level of additional regrowth does not vary by the strictness of protection. As in previous studies of protected area impacts on avoided deforestation, estimators that do not account for nonrandom assignment of protection can overstate protected areas’ impacts on regrowth by nearly double.
abstract_zh: 全球森林生物多样性与生态系统服务的保护工作在很大程度上依赖于保护区。尽管这些区域的首要目标是防止森林砍伐和退化造成的损失，它们也可能有助于生态恢复。以往对保护区影响的评估主要关注避免的森林砍伐和火灾。与之不同，我们关注的是哥斯达黎加著名的国家公园与保护区体系所引致的额外林木再生。我们采用准实验设计，以控制同时影响再生和保护区划定的基线混杂特征。1960至1997年间，估计有13.5%原本无林的保护区内土地因获得保护而实现了再造林。额外的再生水平并不因保护的严格程度而异。与以往关于保护区对避免森林砍伐影响的研究一样，若不考虑保护区划定的非随机性，估计量可能将保护区对再生的影响高估近一倍。

title: Using Non-Pecuniary Strategies to Influence Behavior: evidence from a large-scale field experiment
Do Payments for Environmental Services Reduce Deforestation? A farm-level evaluation from Costa Rica
Evaluation of Biodiversity Policy Instruments: What works and what doesn't?
abstract: We review and confirm the claim that credible evaluations of common conservation instruments continue to be rare. The limited set of rigorous studies suggests that protected areas cause modest reductions in deforestation; however, the evidence base for payments for ecosystem services, decentralization policies and other interventions is much weaker. Thus, we renew our urgent call for more evaluations from many more biodiversity-relevant locations. Specifically, we call for a programme of research—Conservation Evaluation 2.0—that seeks to measure how programme impacts vary by socio-political and bio-physical context, to track economic and environmental impacts jointly, to identify spatial spillover effects to untargeted areas, and to use theories of change to characterize causal mechanisms that can guide the collection of data and the interpretation of results. Only then can we usefully contribute to the debate over how to protect biodiversity in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾并证实了以下论断：对常见保护工具进行可信的评估仍然罕见。有限的严格研究表明，保护区只能适度减少森林砍伐；然而，关于生态系统服务付费、分权政策和其他干预措施的证据基础则薄弱得多。因此，我们再次迫切呼吁，在更多与生物多样性相关的地点开展更多评估。具体而言，我们呼吁开展一项研究计划——“保护评估2.0”（Conservation Evaluation 2.0）——旨在衡量项目影响如何随社会政治和生物物理背景而变化，共同追踪经济和环境影响，识别对非目标地区的空间溢出效应，并利用变化理论来刻画因果机制，从而指导数据收集和结果解释。只有这样，我们才能对发展中国家如何保护生物多样性的辩论作出有益贡献。

title: Forest Figures: Ecosystem services valuation and policy evaluation in developing countries
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: We review the evidence on the economic values of forest ecosystem services in developing nations and the effectiveness of policies aimed at protecting these services. We conclude that, despite a plethora of publications, the literature is thin, with few well-designed studies that can provide a coherent picture of ecosystem values or policy effectiveness. Although ecologists coined the term ecosystem services and have led much of the recent research, ecosystem services is fundamentally an economic concept. This offers economists a unique and important opportunity to contribute to the emerging literature on ecosystem valuation and policy effectiveness. Most importantly, we conclude that the most fruitful path for future inquiry is to more tightly integrate policy and research by conducting studies that combine nonmarket valuation and impact evaluation (i.e., valuation estimates based on observed impacts in the context of real-world programs). We believe that investing scarce research funds in such an integrated approach will increase the likelihood that future research on ecosystem services will yield high-quality evidence of practical use to policymakers.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了发展中国家森林生态系统服务经济价值的证据，以及旨在保护这些服务的政策的有效性。我们得出结论：尽管出版物大量涌现，但文献仍然单薄，设计良好、能够提供关于生态系统价值或政策有效性连贯图景的研究寥寥无几。尽管生态学家创造了“生态系统服务”一词，并引领了近期的大部分研究，但生态系统服务从根本上说是一个经济学概念。这为经济学家提供了独特而重要的机会，去为新兴的生态系统估值和政策有效性文献作出贡献。最重要的是，我们得出结论：未来研究最富成效的路径，是更紧密地整合政策与研究，开展结合非市场估值与影响评估（即基于现实世界项目中观察到的影响得出的估值估计）的研究。我们相信，将稀缺的研究经费投入这种整合性方法，将提高未来生态系统服务研究产生对政策制定者具有实际用途的高质量证据的可能性。

title: Conditions Associated with Protected Area Success in Conservation and Poverty Reduction
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Protected areas are the dominant approach to protecting biodiversity and the supply of ecosystem services. Because these protected areas are often placed in regions with widespread poverty and because they can limit agricultural development and exploitation of natural resources, concerns have been raised about their potential to create or reinforce poverty traps. Previous studies suggest that the protected area systems in Costa Rica and Thailand, on average, reduced deforestation and alleviated poverty. We examine these results in more detail by characterizing the heterogeneity of responses to protection conditional on observable characteristics. We find no evidence that protected areas trap historically poorer areas in poverty. In fact, we find that poorer areas at baseline seem to have the greatest levels of poverty reduction as a result of protection. However, we do find that the spatial characteristics associated with the most poverty alleviation are not necessarily the characteristics associated with the most avoided deforestation. We show how an understanding of these spatially heterogeneous responses to protection can be used to generate suitability maps that identify locations in which both environmental and poverty alleviation goals are most likely to be achieved.
abstract_zh: 保护区是保护生物多样性和生态系统服务供给的主要方式。由于这些保护区往往设立在贫困普遍存在的地区，且可能限制农业发展和自然资源开发，人们担心它们可能造成或强化贫困陷阱。以往研究表明，哥斯达黎加和泰国的保护区体系平均而言减少了森林砍伐并缓解了贫困。我们通过刻画在可观测特征条件下保护反应的异质性，对这些结果进行了更细致的考察。我们没有发现保护区将历史上较贫穷的地区困于贫困的证据。事实上，我们发现，基线时较贫穷的地区似乎从保护中获得了最大程度的减贫效果。然而，我们确实发现，与减贫最相关的空间特征，未必与避免森林砍伐最相关的空间特征相同。我们展示了如何利用对保护反应空间异质性的理解，生成适宜性地图，以识别那些最有可能同时实现环境目标与减贫目标的地点。

title: Persistence of Treatment Effects with Norm-based Policy Instruments: evidence from a randomized environmental policy experiment
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: Policymakers increasingly use norm-based messages to promote conservation efforts. Despite the apparent success of such strategies, empirical analyses have thus far focused exclusively on short-run effects. From a policy perspective, however, whether and how such strategies influence behavior in the long-run is of equal interest. We partner with a metropolitan water utility to implement a natural field experiment examining the effect of such messages on longer-run patterns of water use. Empirical results are striking. While appeals to pro-social preferences affect short-run patterns of water use, only messages augmented with social comparisons have a lasting impact on water demand.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者日益多地使用基于规范的信息来推动保护行动。尽管此类策略看似成功，但实证分析迄今仅关注短期效应。然而，从政策角度看，此类策略是否以及如何在长期影响行为同样值得关注。我们与一家大都市供水公司合作，开展了一项自然实地实验，考察此类信息对长期用水模式的影响。实证结果十分显著。亲社会偏好的诉求虽然影响了短期用水模式，但只有辅以社会比较的信息才能产生持久的影响，从而降低长期的水需求。

title: Protecting Ecosystems and Alleviating Poverty with Parks and Reserves: 'win-win' or tradeoffs?
The Future of Payments for Environmental Services
abstract:
In high-income nations, the concept of PES has gained traction largely because it complements ongoing efforts to redirect agricultural subsidies toward public goods through conservation payment schemes. In low- and middle-income nations, PES has become popular for 4 reasons (Pattanayak et al. 2010). First, weak institutions render regulations, indirect development strategies, and incentive-based quantity strategies (e.g., tradable development rights) difficult. Second, governments prefer subsidies to achieve policy objectives and are increasingly receptive to applying conditionality and performance metrics in the distribution of aid and subsidies. Third, policy makers, practitioners, and donors believe PES can achieve both poverty alleviation and ecosystem protection. Fourth, and perhaps most importantly, practitioners and international aid donors believe PES programs can become self-financing with short-term investments in PES start-up costs and ecosystem valuation (how the public-good nature of the services can be resolved by these investments has not been explained clearly). In other words, PES is perceived as more than just a tool for conservation investment. It is also perceived as a tool for conservation financing. Unfortunately, the reasons that motivate the global popularity of PES also constrain its effectiveness in achieving environmental and social objectives.



I describe what is known about the environmental and social effects of PES and I outline new directions for PES research. I emphasize two points. First, greater use of PES is unwarranted unless new or expanded systems are designed explicitly to measure PES's environmental and social effects and to explore competing notions of effective contract design. Second, efforts to value ecosystem services separate from policies designed to deliver them are wasted. Estimates of the benefits of ecosystem services have no policy relevance unless they are estimated in the context of real conservation effects from real conservation programs.
abstract_zh:
在高收入国家，PES（生态系统服务付费）概念获得了广泛关注，主要是因为它与正在进行的、通过保护付费机制将农业补贴转向公共物品的努力相契合。在中低收入国家，PES之所以流行，有4个原因（Pattanayak et al. 2010）。第一，薄弱的制度使得监管、间接发展战略以及基于激励的数量型策略（例如可交易的开发权）难以实施。第二，政府偏好以补贴实现政策目标，并且日益愿意在援助和补贴的分配中附加条件和绩效指标。第三，政策制定者、实践者与捐助方认为，PES既可以实现扶贫，也可以实现生态系统保护。第四，也许最为重要的是，实践者与国际援助捐助方相信，PES项目可以通过在PES启动成本和生态系统价值评估上的短期投资实现自我融资（这些投资如何解决服务的公共物品属性问题，尚未得到清楚的解释）。换言之，PES不仅被视为保护投资的工具，也被视为保护融资的工具。遗憾的是，推动PES在全球流行的那些原因，同时也限制了其在实现环境与社会目标方面的有效性。



本文阐述了关于PES环境和社会效应的已有认识，并提出了PES研究的新方向。我强调两点。第一，除非新设或扩大的体系被明确设计为衡量PES的环境和社会效应，并探索有关有效契约设计的相互竞争的观点，否则不宜更多地使用PES。第二，将生态系统服务的价值评估与旨在提供这些服务的政策分离开来，是徒劳的。只有在真实保护项目的真实保护效果背景下估算生态系统服务的效益，此类估计才具有政策意义。

title: A Global Review of Incentive Payments for Sea Turtle Conservation
abstract: Performance payment conservation approaches are based on a willing buyer–willing seller model. Sellers deliver conservation outcomes in exchange for a negotiated payment in cash or in kind. The use of performance payments to achieve conservation outcomes is increasingly being used as an alternative to traditional regulatory and development-based approaches in low-income nations. Although payments are increasingly common in terrestrial species and ecosystem conservation initiatives, they are rare in marine conservation efforts such as sea turtle protection. This paper describes sea turtle incentive payment initiatives taking place around the world, most of which are found in projects focusing on nesting beach protection. We find that many of these initiatives have achieved substantial results for a very low annual cost. The potential for expanding payment incentive schemes beyond nest protection to reduce bycatch and hunting pressures on juvenile and adult turtles is unknown but should be further explored.
abstract_zh: 绩效付费的保护方式基于“愿买者与愿卖者”模型。卖方在换取一笔以现金或实物形式协商确定的报酬后，提供保护成果。在低收入国家，越来越多地采用绩效付费来实现保护成果，以替代传统的监管与发展型途径。尽管此类付费在陆生物种和生态系统保护行动中日益普遍，但在海洋保护（如海龟保护）中却较为少见。本文描述了全球范围内的海龟激励性付费项目，其中大多数集中于保护产卵海滩的项目。我们发现，其中许多项目以极低的年度成本取得了可观的成果。将付费激励扩展到减少兼捕以及对幼龟和成年海龟的猎捕压力，其潜力尚不明确，值得进一步探索。

title: A Revealed Preference Approach to Estimating Supply Curves for Ecosystem Services: use auctions to set payments for soil erosion control in Indonesia
abstract: To supply ecosystem services, private landholders incur costs. Knowledge of these costs is critical for the design of conservation‐payment programs. Estimating these costs accurately is difficult because the minimum acceptable payment to a potential supplier is private information. We describe how an auction of payment contracts can be designed to elicit this information during the design phase of a conservation‐payment program. With an estimate of the ecosystem‐service supply curve from a pilot auction, conservation planners can explore the financial, ecological, and socioeconomic consequences of alternative scaled‐up programs. We demonstrate the potential of our approach in Indonesia, where soil erosion on coffee farms generates downstream ecological and economic costs. Bid data from a small‐scale, uniform‐price auction for soil‐conservation contracts allowed estimates of the costs of a scaled‐up program, the gain from integrating biophysical and economic data to target contracts, and the trade‐offs between poverty alleviation and supply of ecosystem services. Our study illustrates an auction‐based approach to revealing private information about the costs of supplying ecosystem services. Such information can improve the design of programs devised to protect and enhance ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 私人土地所有者在提供生态系统服务时需要承担成本。了解这些成本对于设计保护付费项目至关重要。由于潜在供给者可接受的最低报酬属于私人信息，准确估计这些成本十分困难。我们描述了如何设计付费契约拍卖，以便在保护付费项目的设计阶段揭示这一信息。借助试点拍卖得到的生态系统服务供给曲线估计，保护规划者可以探讨不同扩大规模方案的财务、生态与社会经济后果。我们在印度尼西亚展示了该方法的潜力，那里咖啡农场的土壤侵蚀产生了下游的生态与经济成本。一项小规模统一价格拍卖（针对土壤保持契约）所得的投标数据，使我们能够估计扩大规模后项目的成本，估计整合生物物理与经济数据以精准分配契约所获得的收益，以及减贫与生态系统服务供给之间的权衡。我们的研究展示了一种基于拍卖的方法，用以揭示供给生态系统服务成本方面的私人信息。此类信息有助于改进旨在保护和增强生态系统服务的项目设计。

title: Combining Qualitative and Quantitative Methods to Evaluate Participation in Costa Rica's Program of Payments for Environmental Services
abstract: The Costa Rican Program of Payments for Environmental Services provides financial compensation to forest owners for the environmental services generated by their forests. This program offers a unique opportunity to evaluate the impacts of direct incentive payments on conservation. In order to measure the causal effect of this program on outcomes of interest, it is fundamental to understand the factors that influence enrollment in the program. Economic theory suggests that opportunity costs are key, but many factors may determine and mediate the influence of these costs. This article reports findings from an integrated qualitative and quantitative approach to this question. Within an iterative field research framework, information was gathered through (a) semistructured interviews with government officials and forestry professionals, (b) case studies of participant and nonparticipant forest landowners based on in-depth interviews, field visits, and a review of records, and (c) a quantitative survey of participant and nonparticipant landowners. The semistructured interviews and case studies provide important insights that can be incorporated into the quantitative analysis, specifically by identifying potential determinants of program participation and land use change. Hypotheses about the relationship between program participation and the opportunity costs of participation are confirmed using both approaches.
abstract_zh: 哥斯达黎加的环境服务付费计划向森林所有者提供因其森林所产生的环境服务而给予的经济补偿。该计划为评估直接激励支付对保护的影响提供了独特的机会。为了测量该计划对相关结果的因果效应，理解影响参与该计划的因素至关重要。经济理论表明机会成本是关键，但许多因素可能决定并调节这些成本的影响。本文报告了针对这一问题，采用定性与定量相结合方法所得出的发现。在迭代的实地研究框架内，信息通过以下途径收集：（a）对政府官员和林业专业人员进行的半结构化访谈，（b）基于深入访谈、实地考察和记录审查，对参与者和非参与者森林土地所有者进行的案例研究，以及（c）对参与者和非参与者土地所有者进行的定量调查。半结构化访谈和案例研究提供了重要的见解，这些见解可以纳入定量分析，具体而言，即识别项目参与和土地利用变化的潜在决定因素。关于项目参与与参与的机会成本之间关系的假设，通过两种方法均得到证实。

title: Experimental Tests of Ricardian Equivalence with Nondistortionary versus Distortionary Taxes
Park Location Affects Forest Protection: land characteristics cause differences in park impacts across Costa Rica
venue: B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis & Policy
abstract: To support conservation planning, we ask whether a park's impact on deforestation rates varies with observable land characteristics that planners could use to prioritize sites. Using matching methods to address bias from non-random location, we find deforestation impacts vary greatly due to park lands' characteristics. Avoided deforestation is greater if parks are closer to the capital city, in sites closer to national roads, and on lower slopes. In allocating scarce conservation resources, policy makers may consider many factors such as the ecosystem services provided by a site and the costs of acquiring the site. Pfaff and Sanchez 2004 claim impact can rise with a focus upon threatened land, all else equal. We provide empirical support in the context of Costa Rica's renowned park system. This insight, alongside information on eco-services and land costs, should guide investments.
abstract_zh: 为支持保护规划，我们考察公园对毁林率的影响是否随规划者可用于确定优先地点的可观测土地特征而变化。运用匹配方法消除非随机选址所带来的偏差，我们发现，公园的毁林影响因公园土地特征的不同而差异很大。若公园距离首都更近、位于靠近国道的地点，或坡度较低，则避免的毁林量更大。在分配稀缺的保护资源时，政策制定者可能需要考虑多种因素，例如某一地点提供的生态系统服务以及获取该地点的成本。Pfaff和Sanchez（2004）提出，在其他条件相同的情况下，关注受威胁土地可以提高影响。我们以哥斯达黎加著名的公园体系为背景提供了实证支持。这一认识连同有关生态服务和土地成本的信息，应当指导相关投资。

title: Regional Review of Payments for Watershed Services: Sub-Saharan Africa
Asymmetric Information and Contract Design for Payments for Environmental Services
Measuring the Effectiveness of Protected Area Networks in Reducing Deforestation
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Global efforts to reduce tropical deforestation rely heavily on the establishment of protected areas. Measuring the effectiveness of these areas is difficult because the amount of deforestation that would have occurred in the absence of legal protection cannot be directly observed. Conventional methods of evaluating the effectiveness of protected areas can be biased because protection is not randomly assigned and because protection can induce deforestation spillovers (displacement) to neighboring forests. We demonstrate that estimates of effectiveness can be substantially improved by controlling for biases along dimensions that are observable, measuring spatial spillovers, and testing the sensitivity of estimates to potential hidden biases. We apply matching methods to evaluate the impact on deforestation of Costa Rica's renowned protected-area system between 1960 and 1997. We find that protection reduced deforestation: approximately 10% of the protected forests would have been deforested had they not been protected. Conventional approaches to evaluating conservation impact, which fail to control for observable covariates correlated with both protection and deforestation, substantially overestimate avoided deforestation (by over 65%, based on our estimates). We also find that deforestation spillovers from protected to unprotected forests are negligible. Our conclusions are robust to potential hidden bias, as well as to changes in modeling assumptions. Our results show that, with appropriate empirical methods, conservation scientists and policy makers can better understand the relationships between human and natural systems and can use this to guide their attempts to protect critical ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 全球减少热带毁林的努力在很大程度上依赖于设立保护区。衡量这些保护区的成效十分困难，因为在没有法律保护的情况下本会发生的毁林量无法直接观测。传统的保护区成效评估方法可能存在偏误，原因在于保护的分配并非随机，且保护可能引发毁林外溢（转移）至邻近森林。我们表明，通过控制可观测维度上的偏误、测度空间外溢效应，并检验估计结果对潜在隐性偏误的敏感性，可以显著改进成效估计。我们运用匹配方法评估了1960年至1997年间哥斯达黎加著名保护区体系对毁林的影响。我们发现，保护减少了毁林：大约10%的受保护森林在未受保护的情况下将被砍伐。传统的保护影响评估方法未能控制那些与保护和毁林同时相关的可观测协变量，从而大幅高估了避免的毁林量（根据我们的估计，高估幅度超过65%）。我们还发现，从受保护森林到未受保护森林的毁林外溢效应可以忽略不计。我们的结论对潜在的隐性偏误以及模型设定的变化都是稳健的。我们的结果表明，借助恰当的实证方法，保护科学家和政策制定者能够更好地理解人类系统与自然系统之间的关系，并以此指导他们保护关键生态系统服务的努力。

Cost-Effective Conservation When Eco-entrepreneurs have Market Power
abstract: International conservation investments are often made in the form of subsidies to purportedly eco-friendly enterprises rather than as payments conditional on habitat protection. Previous research demonstrated that direct payments for habitat protection are more cost effective than indirect subsidies for the acquisition of com-plementary inputs used in eco-friendly enterprises. In contrast to this earlier research, we assume in this paper that an ‘eco-entrepreneur’ may have market power. Market power is shown to compound the advantage of direct payments. Through a simple numerical example, we show that subsidies intended to achieve habitat conservation by encouraging the acquisition of complementary inputs can be spectacularly inefficient. In some cases it would be cheaper simply to buy the land outright. In other plausible cases, the indirect subsidy approach would simply be unable to achieve habitat conservation objectives no matter how much funding were available.
abstract_zh: 国际保护投资常常以补贴的形式流向所谓的生态友好型企业，而非以以栖息地保护为条件的付费形式进行。以往研究表明，对于栖息地保护而言，直接付费比为获取生态友好型企业所用互补性投入品而提供的间接补贴更具成本效益。与该早期研究不同，本文假定“生态企业家”可能具有市场势力。我们表明，市场势力会放大直接付费的优势。通过一个简单的数值例子，我们说明，旨在通过鼓励获取互补性投入品来实现栖息地保护的补贴可能极度低效。在某些情形下，直接购买土地反而更便宜。在另一些看似合理的情形下，间接补贴方式即使拥有再多资金，也无法实现栖息地保护目标。

venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract:
Failure to consider costs as well as benefits is common in many policy initiatives and analyses, particularly
in the environmental arena. Economists and other policy scientists have demonstrated that integrating both cost
and benefit information explicitly into the policy process can be vital to ensuring that scarce funds go as far as
they can toward achieving policy objectives. The costs of acquiring and analyzing such information, however, can
be substantial. The objective of this paper is to help policy analysts and practitioners identify the conditions
under which integrating cost and benefit information is likely to be vital to effective decisionmaking, and the
conditions under which failing to use both cost and benefit data would result in little, if any, loss in
efficiency. These points are illustrated through a conceptual discussion and an empirical analysis of a
conservation initiative in the United States. © 2003 by the Association for Public Policy Analysis and
Management.
abstract_zh: 许多政策举措和分析中都存在只考虑收益而忽视成本的问题，在环境领域尤为常见。经济学家和其他政策科学家已经证明，将成本与收益信息明确纳入政策过程，对于确保有限资金能够最大限度地服务于政策目标至关重要。然而，获取和分析此类信息的成本可能相当高。本文的目的在于帮助政策分析人员和实践者识别以下两类条件：一是在何种条件下，整合成本与收益信息对于有效决策至关重要；二是在何种条件下，不同时使用成本和收益数据，只会带来很小甚至可以忽略的效率损失。我们通过概念性讨论以及对美国一项保护计划的实证分析来阐明这些观点。© 2003 公共政策分析与管理协会版权所有。

title: Conservation Contracting in Heterogeneous Landscapes: An application to watershed protection with threshold constraints
abstract: A key issue in the design of land use policy is how to integrate information about spatially variable biophysical and economic conditions into a cost-effective conservation plan. Using common biophysical scoring methods, in combination with economic data and simple optimization methods, an illustration is provided for how to identify a set of priority land parcels for conservation investment. This study also demonstrates a way in which conservation agencies can incorporate concerns about biophysical thresholds in the identification of their priority land parcels. These methods are applied using Geographic Information System data from a New York conservation easement acquisition initiative for water quality protection.
abstract_zh: 土地利用政策设计中的一个关键问题，是如何将空间上多变的生物物理与经济条件信息整合进一个具有成本效益的保护规划。本文借助常用的生物物理评分方法，结合经济数据与简单的优化方法，说明了如何识别一组用于保护投资的优先地块。本研究还展示了保护机构如何在确定优先地块时纳入对生物物理阈值的关切。这些方法应用于纽约州一项以水质保护为目标的保护地役权收购计划，使用的是地理信息系统（GIS）数据。

title: Direct Payments for Biodiversity Conservation
Optimizing the Riparian Buffer: Harold Brook in the Skaneateles Lake Watershed, New York
The Cost-effectiveness of Conservation Performance Payments
abstract: International donors invest billions of dollars to conserve ecosystems in low-income nations. The most common investments aim to encourage commercial activities, such as ecotourism, that indirectly generate ecosystem protection as a joint product. We demonstrate that paying for ecosystem protection directly can be far more cost-effective. Although direct-payment initiatives have imposing institutional requirements, we argue that all conservation initiatives face similar challenges. Thus conservation practitioners would be well advised to implement the first-best direct-payment approach, rather than a second-best policy option. An empirical example illustrates the spectacular cost savings that can be realized by direct-payment initiatives. (JEL H21, Q28)
abstract_zh: 国际捐助方为保护低收入国家的生态系统投入了数十亿美元。最常见的投资旨在鼓励生态旅游等商业活动，这些活动会作为联产品间接带来生态系统保护。我们证明，直接为生态系统保护付费可能更具成本效益。尽管直接付费的项目对制度有较高要求，但我们认为所有保护项目都面临类似的挑战。因此，保护实践者最好采用一级最优的直接付费方式，而非次优的政策选项。一个实证例子说明了直接付费项目可以实现的显著成本节约。（JEL H21, Q28）

title: The Local Costs of Establishing Protected Areas in Low-income Nations: Ranomafana National Park, Madagascar
Global Habitat Protection: Limitations of development interventions and a role for conservation performance payments
abstract: Conservation biologists, policy makers, and citizens have identified the protection of native ecosystems in low‐income nations as a global social objective. Among the more popular initiatives toward this objective is the use of development interventions in the peripheral areas of endangered ecosystems. Such interventions indirectly provide desirable ecosystem services by redirecting labor and capital away from activities that degrade ecosystems (e.g., agricultural intensification) and by encouraging commercial activities that supply ecosystem services as joint products (e.g., ecotourism). I examined the economics of such interventions and the available empirical evidence and concluded that development interventions are hindered by (1) the indirect and ambiguous conservation incentives that they generate, (2) the complexity of their implementation, and (3) their lack of conformity with the temporal and spatial dimensions of ecosystem conservation objectives. In contrast, paying individuals or communities directly for conservation performance may be a simpler and more effective approach. In recent years there has been widespread experimentation with contracting approaches to ecosystem conservation. Conservation contracting can (1) reduce the set of critical parameters that practitioners must affect to achieve conservation goals, (2) permit more precise targeting and more rapid adaptation over time, and (3) strengthen the links between individual well‐being, individual actions, and habitat conservation, thus creating a local stake in ecosystem protection. In situations where performance payments are unlikely to work, indirect development interventions are also unlikely to work. Thus, despite the potential barriers to developing a system of conservation contracts in low‐income nations, my analysis suggests that performance payments have the potential to improve the way in which ecosystems are conserved in these nations.
abstract_zh: 保护生物学家、政策制定者和公民已将保护低收入国家的原生生态系统确定为一项全球性社会目标。在实现这一目标的诸多流行举措中，有一种是在濒危生态系统的外围地区实施发展干预。此类干预通过将劳动力与资本从破坏生态系统的活动（如农业集约化）转移出来，并鼓励以联产品形式提供生态系统服务的商业活动（如生态旅游），从而间接提供所需的生态系统服务。我考察了此类干预的经济学原理以及现有的实证证据，得出结论：发展干预受到以下几方面的制约：（1）其所产生的保护激励是间接且含糊的；（2）其实施较为复杂；（3）它们与生态系统保护目标在时间和空间维度上不相匹配。相比之下，直接为个人或社区的保护绩效付费，可能是一种更简单、更有效的途径。近年来，生态系统保护的契约式方法得到了广泛试验。保护契约可以（1）减少实践者为实现保护目标而必须影响的关键参数数量；（2）允许更精准的瞄准，并随时间更快地调整；（3）加强个人福祉、个人行动与栖息地保护之间的联系，从而在生态系统保护中形成地方利益相关方。在绩效付费不太可能奏效的情形下，间接发展干预同样不太可能奏效。因此，尽管在低收入国家建立保护契约体系存在潜在障碍，我的分析表明，绩效付费有潜力改善这些国家保护生态系统的方式。
